verdict.rationale: Log-based CDC is a fair question for an ELT/replication tool like Meltano, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows generic incremental replication state tracking and database connectors. Nothing documents binlog/WAL log-based capture of updates and deletes. Incremental state bookmarking is a different capability from log-based CDC and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I replicate databases with log-based CDC (binlog/WAL) so I capture updates and deletes without hammering the source
